node.title: Re: SSCCE down?
node.author: davies
node.doctext:
Is there a (relatively) easy way to search all your own posts for links to this site? I'd like to change mine to point to [Beech]'s suggested archive, but if I went through over 500 posts I'd (a) be very bored and (b) be sure to miss something.

Regards,

John Davies

Update: thanks for the replies. I should have been able to do it myself, but I so rarely use Super Search that my unaided attempts failed and I couldn't work out a google recipe to give me what I wanted. I've now made the updates. If there's something either Super Search or I have missed, too bad.
